set.body:
Why
The first public cut is 0.1, not 1.0. 1.0 waits until ravel-core has proven itself in sibling consumers and external use.

0.1 acceptance
- Public language, snapshot coordinates, and publication matrix say 0.1
- Packed and stencil stay unpublished experimental modules
- Elementwise NumPy common-ops oracle is a release-gate correctness check
- No binary-compatibility promise beyond the 0.1 line after its exact tag

1.0 later
- Freeze API and MiMa 1.x baseline only after wild use, not as the first publish
set.title: EPIC: Publish ravel-core 0.1, then 1.0 after field use
